''Rosa lucieae'' var. ''genuina'' Franch. & Sav. }} '''''Rosa lucieae''''' ([[synonym (taxonomy)|syn.]] ''Rosa wichuraiana''), the '''memorial rose''', is a species of [[rose]] native to eastern Asia.{{cite book |title=The Oxford English dictionary |url=https://archive.org/details/oxfordenglishdic0006unse |url-access=registration |edition=2nd |year=1989 |publisher=Oxford University Press |location=United Kingdom |isbn=0198611862 |pages=21728}}{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:60464116-2 |title=''Rosa brunanii'' Franch. & Rochebr. ex Crép. |author= |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=18 June 2021 }} ==Description== It is a woody, semi-[[evergreen]] [[shrub]], with long trailing thorny branches of glossy green leaves, and single five-petalled white flowers with prominent yellow [[stamen]]s in Summer; followed by small dark red [[rose hip|hips]]. It can grow to {{cvt|6|m}}. It is named after the German botanist [[Max Ernst Wichura]] (1817–1866), with the suffix [[-ana|-iana]]. ==Uses== While it is valued as a garden plant in its own right, ''R. lucieae'' is also a parent of several rose hybrids, notably [[Rosa 'Dorothy Perkins'|'Dorothy Perkins']], [[Rosa 'Albéric Barbier'|'Albéric Barbier']], [[Rosa 'New Dawn'|'New Dawn']] and [[Rosa 'Albertine'|'Albertine']]. Its vigorous, rambling habit makes it particularly suitable for forming an impenetrable barrier at ground level, or for scrambling up large trees.{{cite book |title=Botanica's roses: the encyclopedia of roses |year=2006 |publisher=Grange books |location=United Kingdom |isbn=1840130415 |pages=704}} It has been introduced to the United States.{{Cite web|url=http://plants.usda.gov/plant-profile?symbol=ROWI|title=USDA Plants Database}} == Gallery == File:Rosa wichuraiana seeds USDA-ARS.jpg|Seeds File:Rosa wichuraiana fruit USDA-ARS.jpg|Fruit File:RosaLuciae11.jpg|Sepals ==References== {{reflist}} {{taxonbar|from1=Q17246292|from2=Q1422123}} [[Category:Roses|lucieae]] [[Category:Flora of Southeast China]] [[Category:Flora of Eastern Asia]] [[Category:Flora of the Philippines]] [[Category:Plants described in 1886]] [[Category:Taxa named by François Crépin]] {{Rosa-stub}}
